--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,26 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
+        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays.")
+    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2D matrices.")
+    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
+        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape.")
+    if logp_with_result.size == 0:
+        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty.")
+    if not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call)):
+        raise ValueError("All values must be finite.")
+    if np.any(logp_with_result > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_no_call > 0):
+        raise ValueError("All values must be nonpositive.")
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean.")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number.")
+
+    # Compute margins: worst-case improvement over future horizon
+    margins = np.min(logp_with_result - logp_no_call, axis=1)
+    # Keep if margin is strictly greater than threshold
+    keep_mask = margins > tau_filter
+    return keep_mask, margins
